text:
ephemeral-alert-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Node group us-west-2-gpu-2 experiencing ephemeral storage saturation. Multiple serve-runtime pods entering CrashLoop/OOMKilled and modelcache eviction observed. Auto-eviction has started for pods with local-storage > 95%.

anita (oncall): ack. I'm looking. Are we seeing 503s for any customers? :eyes:

dmitri: seeing lots of kube events. modelcache writes + log rotation spiking. sample:
```
Events:
  Warning  Evicted   2m   kubelet, ip-10-0-2-45  Pod ephemeral-storage  The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.
  Normal   Killing   1m   kubelet, ip-10-0-2-45  Container runtime terminated.
  Warning  BackOff   40s  kubelet, ip-10-0-2-45  Back-off restarting failed container
```
Container logs show repeated CUDA init failures before crash:
```
serve-runtime[pid=1]: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
serve-runtime[pid=1]: fatal: cannot allocate kv cache
```

kai: confirmed elevated 5xx rate for serve endpoints (p95 latency also ballooned). Chart: https://grafana.internal/serve/panels/ephemeral-saturation (link). CS reported one Dedicated customer with degraded tail latency.

deploy-bot: Canary rollouts paused automatically due to crash thresholds.

anita (oncall): immediate mitigation plan:
1) cordon + drain the two most-saturated nodes in the pool to stop further evictions.
2) run a scripted cleanup on remaining nodes to delete old modelcache artifacts and compress logs.
3) scale up temporary burst nodes with larger ephemeral volumes (if available) or move some heavy models to other regions via routing policy.

maria-ps: looping in customer-success. I'll message affected accounts with a heads-up and ETA.

dmitri: trying the cleanup script now (dry run first):
```
# list oldest modelcache dirs > 7d
ssh node://ip-10-0-2-45 'sudo du -sh /var/lib/modelcache/* | sort -h | tail -n 20'
# remove safe-stale set
ssh node://ip-10-0-2-45 'sudo rm -rf /var/lib/modelcache/stale-*'
```

kai: note: don't delete current active model shards. Use TTL-based artifact pruning only. We should also temporarily disable verbose request logging on that node to reduce disk churn: set SERVE_LOG_LEVEL=warn via rollout patch.

anita (oncall): I've cordoned ip-10-0-2-45 and ip-10-0-2-46 and requested graceful drain with --delete-local-data to free ephemeral. Draining now (expect ~30s per pod to terminate gracefully). :thumbsup:

ops-lead: If drains don't free enough space, prepare to add two burst instances with 1TB ephemeral. Requesting capacity from infra.

customer-success: Customer ping: we saw 15% error rate for requests routed to us-west-2 for ~12 minutes. Most traffic got retried to fallback model variant but some steady clients saw errors due to circuit-breakers. Sending standardized note.

dmitri: cleanup removed ~120GB of stale cache on ip-10-0-2-45. Restarting serve-runtime pods on that node. Monitoring logs; CUDA errors less frequent now. Also rotated modelcache logs:
```
sudo find /var/log/modelcache -type f -mtime +3 -exec gzip {} \;
```

anita (oncall): rolling out log-level change to remaining serve runtime replicas to cut churn.

deploy-bot: Rollout confirmed: SERVE_LOG_LEVEL=warn applied to route /serve-prod (70% complete).

kai: p95 latency recovering, 5xx back down to baseline. Monitoring for 10m.

maria-ps: Customer update posted to #cust-updates and DM'd the dedicated account. No escalations so far. :phone:

anita (oncall): handing off to oncall-next for 1h post-incident watch. Summary: root cause - ephemeral storage churn from unpruned modelcache + verbose logging caused local disk saturation; node-level evictions led to OOM/CUDA symptoms in serve-runtime. Mitigations applied: node drains, TTL-based modelcache prune (120GB freed), log-level reduction, temporary burst capacity requested, routing fallback engaged. Impact: partial request errors (503/504) for ~12 minutes affecting a subset of Dedicated traffic; degradations mitigated by automatic fallback routing.

anita (oncall): paging oncall-next: @dmitri, @kai — please monitor and if p95 > baseline + 30% re-open page. handing off now. :pray:

sre-bot: On-call handover created: from anita to dmitri for 60m. Handoff notes attached.

dmitri: taking over. will watch 30m and then update postmortem draft.

maria-ps: I'll start a customer-impact spreadsheet and tag impacted accounts.

customer-success: scheduling sync with the affected customer in 30 mins to confirm service quality.

anita (oncall): thanks team. Re-open if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
